pageProps.title: Almond
pageProps.review: A review of the novel Almond, which asks the meaning of true empathy in an age of inability to empathize, looking critically at modern society that has become insensitive to the sadness of others, and interpreting the miracle-like ending as the protagonist's hope-filled fantasy.
pageProps.description: A growth narrative written with a cold head and a warm heart
pageProps.content:
## Review It seems to pose a fundamental question about what ```empathy``` is to us living in an age of inability to empathize. It sharply points out the appearance of modern society that has become insensitive to the sadness of others.
Looking at the final scene of this book, it concludes with sudden, nonsensical miracles. So I think this book ultimately ended as a sad ending, leaving behind a fantasy containing the protagonist's hope.
